family: O-1 solver acceptance check, extended to hyperbolic arcs (open item O-12)
description: Deterministic grid of 96 hyperbolic start states and spans (revision 5 §6.8): |a| ∈ {7.0e6, 3.0e7} m, e ∈ {1.25, 1.5, 2.5, 5}, F₀ ∈ {−1, 0, 1}, n_h Δt ∈ {0.05, 0.5, 5, 20}; all inside the §7 VT-16 validity gate; Δt > 0 only.
status: New dataset (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1), committed before any engine run on it (ML-TASK-018 part D3 phase 1). Gated: not compared with the engine before the owner signs revision 5. Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

references: Thresholds: tolerances.md revision 5 §6.8 (ε_t,gen of revision 4, δt_α,hyp of revision 5) transcribed in verification/src/tol/tolerances-r4.ts and tolerances-r5.ts, evaluated in binary64 from the exact input state (§4.1 item 2)
Residual (in the conformance test): verification/src/hp/o1-check-hyp.ts, the universal time equation in 320-bit at the engine χ̂
producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 5 (Proposed, awaiting owner approval; ML-TASK-018 part D3) §6.8 "Extended O-1 check", §12 O-12
tolerance.formula: Pass when |t(χ̂) − Δt| ≤ ε_t,gen(Δt) + δt_α,hyp(Δt), t(χ̂) the universal time equation evaluated in high precision at the engine χ̂ with α, σ₀, r₀ formed in high precision from the exact binary64 input (§6.1 O-1 route (1), extended to E > 0 by revision 5 §6.8). ε_t,gen of §6.8 (revision 4); δt_α,hyp = 5u κ_E(r₀) D(x)/n_h, κ_E(r₀) = 1 + 4|a|/r₀, D(X) = e|sinh F₀|[(cosh X − 1) + X sinh X/2] + (sinh X − X) + (e cosh F₀/2)[(sinh X − X) + X(cosh X − 1)] (revision 5). No margin factor (as the elliptic O-1 threshold).
tolerance.assertion: gated: asserted only after the owner signs revision 5 (§15)
